description.zh: 沿一条线对折、两边完全重合，这条线就是对称轴；绕中心转过某个角度又和原来重合，就是旋转对称——一个靠翻、一个靠转：正方形有 4 条对称轴，平行四边形一条也没有，却转半圈就重合。
description.en: If folding along a line makes the two halves match exactly, that line is an axis of symmetry; if turning about the centre by some angle brings a shape back onto itself, it has rotational symmetry — one is a flip, the other a turn: a square has 4 axes, while a parallelogram has none yet matches itself after half a turn.

en: how many lines of symmetry does a square have

reason.zh: 抛物线左右两边以竖线 x = h 为镜面完全对称：知道对称轴就是“对折能重合的折痕”，顶点式里的 h 就一眼可读。
reason.en: A parabola’s two sides mirror each other across the vertical line x = h: once an axis of symmetry is understood as the fold where the halves match, the h in vertex form can be read at a glance.

label.zh: 交换坐标就是沿对角线翻折
label.en: Swapping coordinates is a flip across the diagonal

reason.zh: 把点 (a, b) 换成 (b, a)，点会沿直线 y = x 翻到对面——这正是以对角线为对称轴的轴对称。
reason.en: Changing a point (a, b) into (b, a) flips it across the line y = x — a reflection with the diagonal as its axis of symmetry.
